meaning.en: The world belongs to everyone; the ideal of a society run for the common good.
meaning.zh: 天下是公众的，指理想的大同社会。

examples.zh: 孙中山先生常题写“天下为公”四个字。
examples.en: Sun Yat-sen often wrote the words 'The world belongs to all'.

examples.zh: 天下为公是古人理想中的社会。
examples.en: A world shared by all was the ancients' ideal society.

story.en: Confucius describes the age of the Great Way, when 'all under heaven was held in common' — the 'Great Unity' (大同).
story.zh: 《礼记·礼运》：“大道之行也，天下为公，选贤与能，讲信修睦。”

usage.en: Predicate or object; formal, political ideal.

synonyms: 有田同耕，有饭同食，有衣同穿，有钱同使，无处不均匀，无人不饱暖
先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐

meaning.en: Attackers outside acting in concert with collaborators inside.
meaning.zh: 外面攻打，里面接应。

equivalents: act in concert from within and without

examples.zh: 敌军里应外合，攻破了城门。
examples.en: With help from inside, the enemy broke through the city gates.

examples.zh: 警方怀疑这起盗窃案是里应外合。
examples.en: The police suspect the theft was an inside job.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 应 is read yìng.

meaning.en: To get on like old friends from the first meeting.
meaning.zh: 初次见面就像老朋友一样投合。

equivalents: get on like a house on fire

examples.zh: 我们俩一见如故，聊了整整一晚。
examples.en: We hit it off immediately and talked all night.

examples.zh: 在会上，他和那位作家一见如故。
examples.en: At the conference, he and the writer got on like old friends.

antonyms: 路遥知马力，日久见人心

pinyin: lù jiàn bù píng, bá dāo xiāng zhù
literal: road · see · not · fair, draw · sword · each other · help
natural: step in to right a wrong

meaning.en: To intervene on behalf of someone being wronged.
meaning.zh: 在路上遇见不公平的事，就挺身而出帮助受欺负的一方。

equivalents: step in to right a wrong

examples.zh: 小伙子路见不平，拔刀相助，制止了小偷。
examples.en: The young man stepped in and stopped the thief.

examples.zh: 他路见不平，挺身而出保护了被欺负的孩子。
examples.en: He couldn't stand by and stood up for the bullied child.

usage.en: Often shortened to 路见不平 + another verb phrase.
usage.zh: 常简作“路见不平”，后接其他动词短语。

synonyms: 路不平有人踩，事不平有人管

meaning.en: To fly into a violent rage.
meaning.zh: 比喻大发脾气，高声训斥。

examples.zh: 听说项目失败，老板大发雷霆。
examples.en: When he heard the project had failed, the boss hit the roof.

examples.zh: 他为这点小事大发雷霆，实在不值得。
examples.en: Flying into a rage over something so small isn't worth it.

meaning.en: To cling stubbornly to a wrong course and refuse to see sense.
meaning.zh: 坚持错误而不醒悟。

examples.zh: 大家都劝他，可他执迷不悟。
examples.en: Everyone tried to talk him round, but he refused to see sense.

examples.zh: 如果执迷不悟，后果不堪设想。
examples.en: If you persist in this, the consequences will be dire.

synonyms: 碰到南墙不回头——死心眼

natural: the way one deals with people

meaning.en: How one treats and gets along with others.
meaning.zh: 指跟别人相处、交往的方式。

examples.zh: 她待人接物彬彬有礼。
examples.en: She is courteous in her dealings with others.

examples.zh: 父母从小教我们待人接物的道理。
examples.en: Our parents taught us from childhood how to treat people.

meaning.en: When desperately ill, one will see any doctor; in a crisis, one tries anything.
meaning.zh: 病情危急时到处乱找医生，比喻事情紧急时什么办法都试。

equivalents: desperate times call for desperate measures

examples.zh: 他是病急乱投医，什么偏方都试。
examples.en: He's clutching at straws, trying every quack remedy.

examples.zh: 找工作也不能病急乱投医。
examples.en: Even when job-hunting, don't grab at anything out of desperation.

meaning.en: To reform oneself thoroughly.
meaning.zh: 清除旧思想，改变旧面貌，比喻彻底悔改。

examples.zh: 出狱后，他洗心革面，重新做人。
examples.en: After prison he turned over a new leaf.

examples.zh: 只要洗心革面，社会会给你机会。
examples.en: If you mend your ways, society will give you a chance.

usage.en: Predicate; often with 重新做人.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“重新做人”连用。

antonyms: 狗改不了吃屎——本性难移

meaning.en: People who share the same misfortune sympathise with each other.
meaning.zh: 比喻有同样不幸遭遇的人互相同情。

examples.zh: 两个失业的人同病相怜，成了好朋友。
examples.en: Both out of work, the two sympathised with each other and became friends.

examples.zh: 我们都没考上，可谓同病相怜。
examples.en: Neither of us got in, so we're in the same boat.

story.en: Wu Zixu takes in the fugitive Bo Pi because both had fathers killed by the king of Chu, quoting a song: 'those with the same illness pity each other'.
story.zh: 《吴越春秋》：“子不闻河上歌乎？同病相怜，同忧相救。”

synonyms: 一根藤上结的苦瓜——苦相连

meaning.en: An incurable disease; also a problem that cannot be fixed.
meaning.zh: 治不好的病，也比喻无法解决的问题。

examples.zh: 她得了不治之症，仍乐观地生活。
examples.en: She has an incurable illness but still lives optimistically.

examples.zh: 拖延是许多人的不治之症。
examples.en: Procrastination is an incurable malady for many people.

meaning.en: Glowing with energy and high spirits.
meaning.zh: 形容兴奋得意、精神焕发的样子。

examples.zh: 他讲起旅行经历，神采飞扬。
examples.en: He was beaming as he talked about his travels.

examples.zh: 获奖的她神采飞扬地走上领奖台。
examples.en: Radiant, she walked up to collect her award.

meaning.en: Those on whom one depends for one's livelihood (e.g. customers).
meaning.zh: 指赖以维持生活的人，如顾客。

examples.zh: 顾客就是我们的衣食父母。
examples.en: Customers are our bread and butter.

examples.zh: 演员要尊重观众，观众是衣食父母。
examples.en: Actors must respect the audience — they're the ones who feed us.

usage.en: Object; often 是……的衣食父母.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“是……的衣食父母”。

meaning.en: Who else but me? — supreme confidence in one's ability or duty.
meaning.zh: 除了我还有谁，形容敢于担当或非常自负。

equivalents: I'm the one for the job

examples.zh: 他有一种舍我其谁的气概。
examples.en: He has an air of 'who else but me?'

examples.zh: 面对重任，她舍我其谁，主动请缨。
examples.en: Facing a heavy task, she stepped forward as the obvious person for it.

story.en: Mencius: 'If Heaven wishes to bring peace to the world, who in this age is there besides me?'
story.zh: 《孟子·公孙丑下》：“如欲平治天下，当今之世，舍我其谁也？”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 舍我其谁的气概.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常说“舍我其谁的气概”。

meaning.en: To know both oneself and one's opponent.
meaning.zh: 既了解自己，也了解对方。

equivalents: know yourself and know your enemy

examples.zh: 知己知彼，百战不殆。
examples.en: Know yourself and your enemy, and you will never be defeated.

examples.zh: 比赛前要研究对手，做到知己知彼。
examples.en: Study your opponent before the match so you know what you're up against.

story.en: Sunzi: 'Know the enemy and know yourself, and in a hundred battles you will never be in peril.'
story.zh: 《孙子·谋攻》：“知彼知己者，百战不殆。”

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate; often followed by 百战不殆.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常接“百战不殆”。

meaning.en: To grind one's teeth in hatred or rage.
meaning.zh: 咬紧牙齿，形容极端愤恨。

examples.zh: 说起那个骗子，她恨得咬牙切齿。
examples.en: Talking about the con man, she ground her teeth in fury.

examples.zh: 他咬牙切齿地发誓要报仇。
examples.en: Seething, he swore revenge.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. 切 is read qiè.

meaning.en: To persuade people with reasoned argument rather than force.
meaning.zh: 用道理使人信服。

examples.zh: 做思想工作要以理服人。
examples.en: When persuading people, use reason, not pressure.

examples.zh: 老师处理矛盾总是以理服人。
examples.en: The teacher always resolves conflicts by reasoning with the pupils.

antonyms: 秀才遇到兵——有理说不清

meaning.en: To turn pale with shock.
meaning.zh: 非常惊恐，脸色都变了。

examples.zh: 看到账单上的数字，他大惊失色。
examples.en: He went white when he saw the bill.

examples.zh: 消息传来，众人大惊失色。
examples.en: When the news arrived, everyone turned pale.

meaning.en: Falling thick and fast (of snow, leaves); also of rumours spreading everywhere.
meaning.zh: 形容雪、花、叶等飘洒得多而杂乱；也指消息传得很广。

examples.zh: 大雪纷纷扬扬下了一夜。
examples.en: Snow swirled down all night.

examples.zh: 这件事传得纷纷扬扬。
examples.en: Word of it spread far and wide.

meaning.en: Ten thousand horses galloping; a scene of great momentum and vigour.
meaning.zh: 成千上万匹马在奔跑，形容声势浩大或气势雄壮。

examples.zh: 黄河水像万马奔腾一样涌来。
examples.en: The Yellow River surged on like a thundering stampede.

examples.zh: 这幅画描绘了万马奔腾的壮观场面。
examples.en: The painting shows a magnificent scene of galloping horses.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 如/像万马奔腾.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常说“如万马奔腾”。

meaning.en: Bare-handed, unarmed; also with nothing to rely on.
meaning.zh: 两手空空，没有武器，也比喻没有任何凭借。

examples.zh: 他赤手空拳制服了歹徒。
examples.en: He overpowered the attacker with his bare hands.

examples.zh: 当年他赤手空拳来到深圳创业。
examples.en: Back then he came to Shenzhen with nothing and started a business.

natural: a matter of life and death

meaning.en: A moment when life or death hangs in the balance.
meaning.zh: 关系到生存或死亡的关键时刻。

equivalents: a matter of life and death

examples.zh: 在生死关头，他把救生衣让给了别人。
examples.en: At the moment of life and death, he gave his life jacket to someone else.

examples.zh: 企业到了生死关头，必须改革。
examples.en: The firm is at a make-or-break moment and must reform.

meaning.en: To hide one's abilities and bide one's time.
meaning.zh: 隐藏才能，不使外露，等待时机。

examples.zh: 他韬光养晦多年，终于一鸣惊人。
examples.en: After years of biding his time, he made a stunning breakthrough.

examples.zh: 公司选择韬光养晦，专心研发。
examples.en: The company chose to keep a low profile and focus on R&D.

meaning.en: To act on emotion or impulse rather than reason.
meaning.zh: 凭一时的感情冲动处理事情。

equivalents: act in the heat of the moment

examples.zh: 遇事要冷静，不能意气用事。
examples.en: Keep calm and don't act on impulse.

examples.zh: 他一时意气用事，辞掉了工作。
examples.en: In the heat of the moment, he quit his job.

meaning.en: Having fought countless battles; highly experienced.
meaning.zh: 亲身经历过许多战斗，比喻经验丰富。

examples.zh: 他是一位身经百战的老将。
examples.en: He's a battle-hardened veteran.

examples.zh: 这支球队身经百战，不会轻易认输。
examples.en: This seasoned team won't give up easily.

synonyms: 孙悟空进了八卦炉——越炼越结实
antonyms: 赵括徒读父书——纸上谈兵
温室里的花朵——经不起风雨
小庙里的和尚——没见过大香火
